title: Banks Act Directive D1/2024 — Pillar 3 disclosure requirements for interest rate risk in the banking book
enablingLegislation: Section 6(6)(a) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990)

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: This directive is issued by the Prudential Authority in terms of Section 6(6)(a) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Pillar 3 disclosure requirements for interest rate risk in the banking book.

sections.heading: Application
sections.text: This directive applies to all banks, branches of foreign institutions and controlling companies registered or operating in South Africa in terms of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Pillar 3 disclosure requirements for interest rate risk in the banking book.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: Pillar 3 disclosure requirements for interest rate risk in the banking book. Institutions are required to ensure compliance with the requirements set out herein. This directive remains effective as confirmed in Banks Act Circular 1 of the relevant year.
